answer: Sybils profit only if each fake identity earns separately, so cap pay per correlated cluster, not per account. Build a graph linking agents whose answers, timing and attestation partners move together; a tightly linked spiral shares one reward pot, however many nodes it contains. Honest agents, with varied partners and work, stand apart like saffron threads in rice or a lone opal in matrix, and keep full pay. To escape the cap a farm must run truly independent agents for months, erasing its scale advantage.
